scope: Exploratory after primary results known; no new physical chains. Block-aligned contiguous and dispersed intact 100-frame blocks, NOT dispersed individual frames.
reference: For each held-out seed, equal EDH means of other two 80k chains only. Same weighted NRMSE and domain as primary. Gaussian multiplier reference norm95 and compatibility as stage4; retain all failures.
sampling: Common block indices across seeds and EDH/EFS. Ascending M, uniform 200 contiguous starts in 0..800-M/100; then 200 sorted no-replacement subsets of M/100 intact blocks. Blocks not asserted independent.
intervals: Paired repeat bootstrap conditional on fixed pools and references. Not independent seed replication because rotations overlap. No universal CI or primary threshold substitution.
judgment: Report all RMS ratios and conditional intervals, separate reference precision and compatibility. No new frame-saving claim from this block design; no M50. Preserve residual heterogeneity and all data.
